newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany cracks down in gadget risks in flight.
newsitem.headline: Germany cracks down in gadget risks in flight.

text.p: The German government agreed on Wednesday on a draft law that could send air travellers to jail for using mobile telephones, laptop computers, video cameras and a range of other electronic devices in flight.
The ban would cover any equipment that could endanger the aircraft by affecting its electronics and communications. Punishment could be a fine or a jail term of up to two years.

Details of the regulations were not announced but the law could come into effect around the middle of 1998 if passed by parliament. The use of electronic devices in flight is not currently punishable under German law.
Transport Minister Matthias Wissmann has said he wants to put Germany's air safety regulations among the tightest in the world.
A Transport Ministry spokesman said the ban was intended to cover all aircraft using German airspace. Other countries' laws varied greatly, he said.
